quests.title: The Drowned Bell of St. Jude
quests.reward: 350 GP + 1x Potion of Water Breathing & Silver Reliquary
quests.summary: Recover the consecrated silver bell sunken in the flooded catacombs before cultists defile it with necromantic ichor.

objectives.text: Locate the submerged entrance beneath the Sunken Ward boardwalks
Navigate the flooded crypts and defeat the drowned undead
Retrieve the Silver Bell from the altar of the drowned martyr
Return the relic to the Chapel of the Dawn without Syndicate interference

quests.notes: Watch out for deep water currents; Sister Andrea warned that necrotic energy may animate skeletons with grasping claws.

quests.title: Intercepting the Red-Wax Manifest
quests.reward: 500 GP + Favor of the Silver Gauntlet (Reputation +1)
quests.summary: Acquire the ledger detailing the Syndicate's corrupt harbor contacts before it is handed off at midnight.

objectives.text: Stake out The Rusted Anchor taproom before 11:00 PM
Identify the courier carrying the red-wax seal
Secure the manifest via stealth, charm, or force
Deliver the ledger to Highspire Bastion untouched

quests.notes: The courier is rumored to travel with two disguised veterans.

quests.title: Sabotage at Forge #4
quests.reward: 300 GP + 1x Masterwork Weapon (+1 to Attack or Damage)
quests.summary: Investigate why the grand blast furnace has been misfiring and threatening to explode the ironworks.

objectives.text: Inspect the fuel intake line for alchemical tampering
Apprehend the saboteur hired by rival merchants

quests.notes: Hrogar suspects a Gilded Scales merchant bribed someone to delay shipments.

quests.title: Bounty: Gnasher the Bone-Splitter
quests.summary: Clear out the goblin raiders ambushing flour wagons along the north highway.

objectives.text: Track the raiding party to their ravine hideout
Defeat Chief Gnasher and his wolf pack

quests.notes: Completed on Day 2. The town bailiff paid the bounty in silver crowns.

rumors.text: Fishermen swear they saw green witchfire glowing under the water by the old sunken bell tower at low tide.
The Gilded Scales are funding an expedition to buy out all silver mines in the Ironpeaks, planning a cartel monopoly.
A nobleman's daughter was seen visiting the Pale Moon apothecary in the dead of night disguised in a velvet cowl.
The sewer rats under the bazaar have doubled in size and now walk on two legs like men.
